meaning:
ἔκ-γονος, -ον
(ἐκγίγνομαι, to be born of), [in LXX for פְּרִי (neut.), בֵּן, etc. ;]
1. with genitive, born of.
2. As subst., ὁ, ἡ ἔ., a child, son or daughter; in pl., descendants: τέκνα ἢ ἔ., children or grand-children, 1Ti.5:4.†
(AS)

elsewhere.note: But if any widow has children or grandchildren, let them learn first to show piety toward their own family and to repay their parents, for this is acceptable…
